remarks: Fabulous corner-unit townhome in the heart of New Canaan. This bright and beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers the perfect blend of style, space, and convenience. Flooded with natural light, the home features an open flow ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to your own large private terrace-a rare find, perfect for alfresco dining, morning coffee, or quiet evenings. Additional highlights include a detached garage for added storage and convenience. Enjoy resort-style living with access to two community pools, plus New Canaan's award-winning schools, vibrant downtown, and easy commuter access-all from this exceptional corner location.
